title: Isolation banner themes: fields, limits and the default theme

prose.text: Whether banner themes can be managed through an API, SDK or Terraform is open {{gap:automation-surfaces}}.

checks.do: Whether the banner theme the profile uses has the show toggle turned off.

per-profile-assignment.statement: Isolation banner notifications are assigned per isolation profile, for both Internet & SaaS and Private Access, and appear in the web browser when a user enters an isolated session.

quotes: When a user in your organization enters an isolated session, a notification appears to them in the web browser.
The notification banners are assigned per isolation profile.
The notification banners are assigned per isolation profile.
When a user in your organization enters an isolated session, a notification appears to them in the web browser.

default-theme.statement: The Default banner theme is applied to all isolation profiles unless a profile is edited to use a different theme; it cannot be deleted but can be edited (stated in both the Internet & SaaS and Private Access articles).

quotes: The Default banner theme is automatically applied to all the isolation profiles in your organization, unless you edit a specific profile to have a different banner theme.
You cannot delete the Default banner theme, but you can edit it.
The Default banner theme is automatically applied to all the isolation profiles in your organization, unless you edit a specific profile to have a different banner theme.
You cannot delete the Default banner theme, but you can edit it or edit an existing theme.

custom-themes-unlimited.statement: Admins can create and edit as many custom banner themes as they want and can delete any theme that is not the default.

quotes: They can create and edit as many custom themes as they want, and delete any that are not the default theme.
They can create and edit as many custom themes as they want, and delete any that are not the default theme.

logo-image-limit.statement: A banner theme logo image must be .jpeg or .png and at most 100 KB, in both products.

quotes: Logo Image in a .jpeg or .png format. The maximum file size is 100 KB.
Logo Image in a .jpeg or .png format. The maximum file size is 100 KB.

persist-banner-15-seconds.statement: Enabling Persist Browser Isolation Banner keeps the banner for the whole isolation session without it disappearing after 15 seconds, in both products.

quotes: Enable or disable Persist Browser Isolation Banner. Enabling this means the banner persists throughout the duration of the isolation session without disappearing after 15 seconds.
Enable or disable Persist Browser Isolation Banner. Enabling this means the banner persists throughout the duration of the isolation session without disappearing after 15 seconds.

show-toggle.statement: Turning off the show toggle means the end-user notification does not appear for any profile using that banner theme; the toggle is labelled Show isolation banner in Internet & SaaS and Show Welcome Notification in Private Access.

quotes: Enable or disable Show isolation banner. Disabling this means the end-user notification does not appear in the isolated session for any profiles using this banner theme.
Enable or disable Show Welcome Notification. Disabling this means the end-user notification does not appear in the isolated session for any profiles using this banner theme.

mobile-links-disabled.statement: In mobile isolation, links added to the banner Notification Text are disabled by default.

quotes: When in mobile isolation, links added to the Notification Text are disabled by default.
When in mobile isolation, links added to the Notification Text are disabled by default.

theme-fields.statement: A banner theme has a Theme Name, Logo Image, Primary Color shown on the banner background, Text Color, Notification Title and Notification Text.

quotes: Enter the Theme Name.
Select the Primary Color that displays on the banner background.
Select the Text Color.
Enter the Notification Title.
Enter the Notification Text.
Click Choose File to select the Logo Image in a .jpeg or .png format.

delete-not-default.statement: Any banner theme except the Default can be deleted, in both products.

quotes: You can delete any banner theme except the Default.
You can delete any banner theme except the Default.

automation-surfaces.title: Whether Internet & SaaS banner themes can be managed through the API, SDKs or Terraform
automation-surfaces.detail: The help articles describe the console only. For the Private Access side, banners are CBI configuration operations ([[zbi.api]]), the create path is in [[zpa.api.cbi-appprotection-wire:cbi-singular-create-path]] and the banner logo limit in [[zpa.terraform.resource-constraints:cbi-banner-logo-limit]]. Open is only the Internet & SaaS side: whether its banner themes can be managed through an API, SDK or Terraform; those sources were not checked.
